ca9a993417.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Marketing & Management leaders imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts — and crafting the narratives that bring those products to the world.

They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking, deep research, and compelling go-to-market storytelling.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, marketing, and communications, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

You will be part of the team responsible for product roadmaps and launches at Airbnb. You will drive specific features that are part of every launch and determine how they are positioned and communicated to the external world. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release to growth. And your cross-functional work ensures a consistent product voice across the experiences being built at Airbnb.

We are seeking a Product Marketing & Management leader to join our Tickets team. Tickets is a new and fast-growing business spanning attractions, tours, and live events, and you'll be at the forefront of defining the category for Airbnb — shaping a product guests love, building the supply that powers it, and telling the story that brings it to market. This is an exciting opportunity to stand up a business from the ground up and leave a lasting impact on how the world explores and connects.

· Develop and maintain a product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Airbnb Tickets.

· Synthesize guest, host, and partner feedback and translate it into product features and positioning.

· Develop the public-facing messaging and narrative for Tickets, and land the value proposition with guests, supply partners, and the media.

· Align product teams and cross-functional partners across marketing, communications, and PMM.

· Develop partnerships with attractions operators, tour providers, and live event suppliers, with a focus on both supply and demand.

· Ensure the existing storefront is healthy and the quality bar is high across ticket listings.

· Role model behaviors that encourage open communication and curiosity.

· Make judgements and prioritization decisions that are in the best interests of our users.

· Efficiently execute to ship products and deliver impact for our business and users.

· 10+ years of product management and/or product marketing experience.

· Experience creating product messaging and positioning and delivering it to customers and the media.

· Demonstrated inbound and subject matter expertise, ideally in ticketing, travel, events, or marketplace businesses.

· Background in ticketing marketplaces, including hands-on experience with operator and supply-side tools and with ticketing standard APIs and integrations (e.g., reservation and distribution systems, connectivity platforms, barcode/QR validation).

· Requirements gathering & documentation — framed around turning ambiguous problems into clear specs that align eng, design, and partners.

· Backend ticketing data model — ticket types, fare/price classes, entitlements, and how those relationships structure inventory.

· Inventory & availability modeling — capacity, time slots, holds, and real-time availability across supply sources.

· Able to build compelling customer-focused stories and work with marketing and communications partners to bring them to life.

· Excited to build a new business that brings the best possible ticketing experience to all the guests and hosts on our platform.

· Demonstrated track record of product leadership in a cross-functional environment.

· Built and scaled global consumer products, marketplaces, or ecosystems that people love.

· Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality and leading teams through a dynamic environment.

· Experience working on consumer products that drive significant revenue.

· A strong ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy and go-to-market decisions.

· Excited to drive execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.

· Enjoys doing individual contributor product and product marketing work and staying in the details.

· Strong ability and desire to travel frequently, including domestic and international.

Unser Kunde ist ein großer deutscher Dienstleistungskonzern mit einem sehr großen Endkundenstamm und hohem Serviceaufkommen am Telefon. Diesen Service entwickelt er mit KI und Automatisierung konsequent weiter: einfache Anliegen übernimmt zunehmend die Technologie, die Menschen konzentrieren sich auf das Komplexe.

Wir suchen den Kopf, der diese KI-gestützte Contact-Center-Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb aufbaut, ein eigenes Team dafür führt und den telefonischen Kundenservice damit auf die nächste Stufe hebt.
​
Deine Aufgaben
Mit direkter Berichtslinie zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice trägst Du die volle Verantwortung für die Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb, führst ein eigenes interdisziplinäres Team und schlägst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Das beinhaltet im Detail:
Du konzipierst die Lösung und treibst die Automatisierung im telefonischen Service voran.
Du übersetzt die Anforderungen in klare User Stories für Voice- und Chatbots und verantwortest den Backlog.
Du steuerst die Umsetzung Ende zu Ende, mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung von Projektzielen und Budget bis zur Führung eines interdisziplinären, agilen Teams.
Du führst Telefonie, CRM und Bots gemeinsam mit der IT zu einer Plattform zusammen und gestaltest ihr Zusammenspiel.
Du hast den Markt im Blick, entscheidest über den Einsatz neuer Technologien und verantwortest Qualität und Effizienz im Kundenkanal.
​
Dein Profil
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner / Produktmanager an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT im Bereich Voice oder Conversational AI.
Du hast selbst Voicebots, Sprachdialogsysteme oder eine Contact-Center-Automatisierung in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht, gern mit Plattformen wie Cognigy, Genesys, Five9 oder CCAI.
Du kennst den telefonischen Kundenservice aus der Praxis und hast dort Verantwortung getragen.
Du arbeitest agil, User Stories sind für Dich selbstverständlich; Zertifizierungen wie Scrum, PRINCE2 oder PMP sind ein Plus.
Du beherrschst Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1). Die Lösung steuert einen deutschsprachigen Kundenservice und ist ohne dieses Niveau nicht besetzbar.
​
Wir bieten
Eine Plattform, die Du gestaltest, nicht ein bestehendes System, das Du verwaltest.
Verantwortung im Aufbau, mit eigenem Team, eigenem Budget und direktem Draht zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice.
Eine exponierte Rolle, die Service, Produkt und KI verbindet und Dich für die nächste Führungsaufgabe aufstellt.
Ein attraktives, der Verantwortung entsprechendes Vergütungspaket
​
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst Du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach Deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch. Bitte lade aber vorher Deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Product Manager, Fraud and Compliance, joining the Fintech area

As Remote grows and handles larger transaction volumes across countries, so does our exposure to fraud, credit risk, and compliance risk. This role owns the systems and strategies that protect Remote and its customers — from onboarding verification and screening, to credit risk assessment and reserve management, to fraud detection and enforcement across the full customer lifecycle.

You'll drive the evolution of our risk and compliance capabilities from reactive, rule-based controls toward proactive, automated systems that identify risk signals early and scale without proportional increases in manual effort. This is a high-autonomy, high-stakes role. You'll report to the Director of Product and work closely with Risk, Compliance, Treasury, Legal, Collections, and Engineering.

· Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code is required. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs.

· AI fluency. You have a point of view on how AI and automation can transform risk operations — from pattern detection to anomaly scoring to compliance workflows.

· Seasoned Product Manager, with a track record on platform, API, or products for operational teams.

· Platform mindset. You build systems others can extend. Scalability means growing the business without proportional increases in manual work or complexity.

· Strong UX sensibilities . Risk and compliance tooling doesn't have to be painful. You care about the admin experience as much as the customer-facing one.

· Outstanding communication and collaboration skills. You partner effectively with compliance, engineering, design, treasury, and legal — and you lead by example on async workflows.

· Data-driven decision-making. Comfortable querying data and working with visualisation tools, you let insights drive your prioritisation.

· Fast learner with a growth mindset. You're humble, eager to learn, and get up to speed quickly in new territory, then pass on what you pick up so the whole team levels up.

Prototype rapidly.

Use tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Codex, or similar to explore, validate, and demonstrate new ideas yourself, so you can align a team on direction with a working artifact rather than a document. Compress the busywork .

Apply AI to speed up research synthesis, requirements drafting, data exploration, and analysis so you spend your time on judgment, strategy, and customer understanding. Build AI into the product.

Identify where copilots, agents, and intelligent automation genuinely improve the customer experience, and partner with engineering on what to build and how it should behave across success, failure, and edge cases.

The Opportunity

Our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) platform is the operating system for MongoDB's entire partner ecosystem — the system partners and internal teams rely on for onboarding, deal registration, enablement content, incentives, and reporting.

We're looking for a Director, Business Product Manager to own the business vision and requirements for this platform: the strategic counterpart to the engineering/IT team that builds it.

This is a business-side role — you won't be writing code — but you need to understand PRM deeply enough to translate partner and internal stakeholder needs into a clear product vision, a prioritized roadmap, and requirements engineering can build against.

You'll report to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and work as the connective tissue between the partner organization (Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations) and the engineering/IT teams who build and maintain the platform.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Palo Alto for our hybrid working model.

Own the vision and strategy

· Define and own the long-term business vision and strategy for the PRM platform, anchored in the needs of partners and internal partner-organization stakeholders.

· Build and maintain a prioritized product roadmap that balances competing demands from Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations, and field/partner-facing teams.

· Stay current on PRM market direction (Salesforce PRM, Impartner, Workspan, Zift, Crossbeam, and emerging AI-native entrants) to inform build-vs-buy and platform evolution decisions.

· Run structured discovery with stakeholders across the partner organization to surface needs, pain points, and opportunities, and translate them into clear, prioritized requirements.

· Author business requirements documents (BRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and IT can build against without ambiguity.

· Maintain and groom the product backlog, balancing new capability requests against platform stability, data quality, and technical debt considerations raised by engineering.

Work cross-functionally to deliver

· Act as the primary business-side liaison to Engineering/IT and any implementation partners or vendors, ensuring business intent survives translation into technical delivery.

· Partner closely with the Digital Process & AI Operations lead to align on which PRM capabilities should be built as native platform features versus automations layered on top.

· Lead or participate in UAT (user acceptance testing) cycles to confirm delivered functionality meets business requirements before release.

· Drive change management and adoption for new PRM capabilities — communication, training materials, and enablement content in partnership with the Enablement team.

Measure and iterate

· Define and track adoption and health metrics for the PRM platform (partner activation, feature adoption, ticket/escalation volume, NPS or satisfaction where available).

· Report platform performance and roadmap progress to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and other partner-organization stakeholders on a regular cadence.

· Continuously reprioritize the roadmap based on usage data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving partner-ecosystem strategy.

· 8+ years of experience in product management, business systems, or business analysis roles, ideally with direct exposure to PRM, CRM, or other partner/channel technology platforms at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure/data company.

· Familiarity with how AI is being applied to PRM and partner ecosystem tooling (e.g., AI-assisted deal registration, partner health scoring).

· Background in cloud infrastructure, database, or developer-focused technology markets.

· A clearly articulated, leadership-endorsed vision and roadmap for the PRM platform.

· A well-groomed backlog of BRDs and user stories that engineering can execute against with minimal rework.

· A track record of successful releases, each validated through UAT and adopted smoothly by partner-organization teams and partners themselves.

· Established reporting on platform health and adoption that leadership uses to make ongoing investment decisions.

At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first

Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.

Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.
Collaborating across teams

Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.
Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.

That surface is about to matter more than ever. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the marketplace, the two-sided surface where Partners and developers publish integrations and where Supabase's developer customers discover and install them.
Make it effortless for a developer to find the right capability and integrate it. Own discovery, search, listings, and the whole path from install to working integration, so a new capability connects to Supabase primitives and runs inside a developer's project with minimal glue code.
Make publishing an integration fast and rewarding, so Partners and developers bring their best work to the marketplace and keep it current, and so the catalog stays deep where developers need it.
Set the quality bar and the listing standards, and build the review, guardrail, and versioning mechanisms, with Engineering and our Partnerships team, that keep the catalog trustworthy as it scales.
Own what a healthy marketplace looks like: define the metrics across both supply and demand, instrument the surface end to end, and let the signal rather than opinion drive what gets built next.
Position the marketplace as the distribution layer for agent-driven development, where capabilities get discovered and composed on a builder's behalf rather than browsed and installed by hand.

At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.
Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation.

This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team.

If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.

As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants.
Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team.

Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics.
In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products.
What You Will Be Doing
Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch.
Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers.
Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants.
Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes.
Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs.
Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes.
Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world.
What Success Looks Like
Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases.
Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows.
Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods.
Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods.

Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment.
Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions based on insights rather than intuition.
Technical Fluency: Experience working with APIs, automation tools, and technical teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.
Customer-Obsessed Mindset: Ability to deeply understand user needs and translate them into frictionless product experiences.
Exceptional Collaboration Skills: Ability to work effectively with engineering, compliance, commercial teams, and external stakeholders.
Bias for Action: A pragmatic approach to decision-making, balancing long-term vision with near-term execution.
Languages: English, Portuguese and Spanish are a must.
What's in it for you?
Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance.
Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side

Remote - Georgia (Tbilisi), Serbia, Spain, Poland, Germany About Zencargo Zencargo is building a world of smarter trade. We combine expert global freight forwarding (ocean, air, road, rail) with Luca, our AI co-pilot, to deliver real-time visibility, proactive exception management, and supply chains that become customers' competitive advantage.

Join us to shape products that automate logistics, reduce disruptions, and drive measurable efficiency for global shippers. The Opportunity We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to take ownership of a meaningful area of the Zencargo platform and help transform how global freight is managed.

This is an opportunity to digitise and automate complex processes in an industry that still relies heavily on manual work, emails, spreadsheets, and operational knowledge. You will work on products that serve customers, suppliers, freight partners, and our internal operations teams, solving real-world problems across international supply chains.

AI is central to both what we build and how we work. You will help identify and deliver AI-powered features that improve supply chain efficiency, while also using modern AI tools throughout discovery, analysis, prototyping, specification, and delivery.

You will join a product team, work directly with senior leadership, and partner with a dedicated design and engineering squad. The role offers significant autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to influence both our product strategy and how we develop software.

You will own a meaningful product area and its outcomes end to end, from understanding customer and operational problems through to discovery, prioritisation, delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

This is not a narrowly defined delivery role: you will be expected to shape the problems the squad works on, challenge assumptions, and provide clear recommendations about where we should invest.

Product areas could include booking and shipment workflows, purchase-order management, customer visibility, operational automation, exception management, and AI-powered productivity features.

What you'll Do Own the vision, priorities, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for your product area, balancing customer value, operational impact, commercial priorities, and technical complexity.

Lead discovery and prioritisation for complex customer and operational problems, using user research, product and operational data, market insight, and commercial context to determine where the team should focus.

Experience working closely with engineers and designers throughout discovery, solution design and delivery, without relying on heavy hand-offs or excessive documentation. Map and redesign freight and operational processes to identify opportunities for technology, automation, and AI to reduce friction and improve decision-making.

Define success measures before development begins and use product data, customer feedback, and operational insight to assess whether released solutions are delivering the intended outcome. Take responsibility for initiatives beyond launch, ensuring solutions are adopted, create measurable value, and are improved based on evidence.

Facilitate sessions and communicate effectively to align product, engineering, design, operations, commercial, and leadership teams around priorities and decisions. Contribute to the broader product strategy and roadmap that advances our vision of intelligent supply chains.

Use AI tools as part of your day-to-day product practice to improve the speed and quality of research, analysis, prototyping, communication, and delivery. What Success Looks Like First 30 days : Build a strong understanding of our customers, internal operations, platform, product strategy, technical landscape, and current squad priorities.

Establish trusted relationships with engineering, design, and key business stakeholders. First 90 days : Take clear ownership of a product area, validate its highest-priority customer and operational problems, establish measurable outcomes, and lead at least one meaningful initiative into delivery.

First six months : Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed customer, operational, or commercial outcomes, such as increased product adoption, reduced manual work, faster workflow completion, or improved shipment reliability.

Ongoing : Consistently identify and solve valuable problems, make strong prioritisation decisions, and deliver improvements that create measurable value for customers and the business.

What We're Looking For Experience as a Product Manager with a track record of shipping impactful software products or features, ideally in SaaS, logistics, supply chain technology, or another operationally complex environment. Experience owning a product area or complex problem space, rather than only managing a backlog or coordinating delivery.

Strong product judgement, with the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs between customer value, operational impact, commercial priorities, and technical complexity. Strong user research, data analysis, process mapping, and facilitation skills.

Experience working closely with engineers and designers throughout discovery, solution design and delivery, without relying on heavy hand-offs or excessive documentation.

Recent, hands-on experience using modern AI tools to improve product discovery, research, analysis, prototyping, specification, or delivery, alongside experience contributing to an AI-enabled product or feature.

Confidence working directly with senior leaders, communicating complex issues clearly, and influencing decisions through evidence, product insight, and sound judgement. You will be comfortable operating with ambiguity, challenging established processes and adapting your approach as new information emerges.

A versatile, hands-on working style, with the ability to move between strategic thinking, detailed discovery, stakeholder alignment, and supporting delivery. Nice-to-Haves: Domain knowledge in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain. Experience in a startup, scale-up, or fast-growth technology environment.

Experience building products for operational users as well as external customers. Familiarity with ThoughtSpot or similar analytics and business intelligence tools. Originally posted on Himalayas
